name: com.feode/feode-mcp
title: FEODE Capability Server
description: FEODE (Shenzhen Far East Oil Drilling Engineering) — query offshore well plug & abandonment, subsea wellhead systems (BV + CCS classed), continuous circulation drilling, completion, drill pipe, fishing, supervision; plus a NOV Grant Prideco drill-string spec reference and operating guidance (make-up torque, handling, sour-service grades).

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: FEODE company profile: legal name, founding year (1985), HQ, Huizhou manufacturing/test base, areas served, contact.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List FEODE's 7 product/service lines (id, name, category).

tools.name: get_product_specs
tools.description: Detailed specs/highlights for one product line by id.

tools.name: get_certifications
tools.description: FEODE certifications: BV + CCS classification of the subsea wellhead system, 8 API monogram licenses, ISO 9001/14001/45001, national awards.

tools.name: list_drill_pipe
tools.description: List NOV Grant Prideco drill string reference items (drill pipe, HWDP, drill collars).

tools.name: get_drill_pipe_specs
tools.description: Full performance specs for one drill string item by id (pipe body, tool joint, make-up torque, drift).

tools.name: search_drill_pipe
tools.description: Keyword search the NOV Grant Prideco drill string spec reference.

tools.name: get_drill_string_guidance
tools.description: NOV Grant Prideco operating guidance: make-up torque rules, grip/handling distances, care & handling, double-shoulder connections, sour-service grades.
